# Lab Template

## Title

## Purpose
What this lab makes observable or practiceable.

## Learning objectives
- ...

## Estimated time

## Environment and prerequisites

## Setup

## Baseline
Establish the starting behavior or model.

## Predict
Ask what should happen before running the key step.

## Experiment / implementation
Focused steps with starter code rather than fully completed copy/paste code.

## Observe
Specify what metrics, output, visual, or behavior to inspect.

## Explain
Ask why the result occurred.

## Challenge
A constrained modification, debugging task, or comparison.

## Checkpoint
A concrete success condition or sanity range.

## Troubleshooting
Likely failure -> likely cause -> fix.

## Takeaways
3-5 concise conclusions.

## Optional extension
Clearly separate from required work.
